title: MINUTE and SECOND add 0.5/86400 (half a second) to the serial before extracting fractional time components
statement: In Excel 16.0.20527.20088, MINUTE and SECOND round the serial to the nearest second by adding 0.5/86400 before decomposing the fractional day into hours, minutes, and seconds. Thus MINUTE(0.5 + 1/86400/2) rounds 12:00:00.5 up to 12:00:01 and returns 0, and SECOND(0.5 + 1/86400*1.5) rounds 12:00:01.5 to 12:00:01 or 12:00:02 according to binary64 evaluation, returning 1.
basis: Measured in Excel 16.0.20527.20088 in f2_rows (rows 116-117) and matched across 14,631/14,631 MINUTE and 14,631/14,631 SECOND full-bank rows plus 120/120 pinned rows each in Excel 16.0.20430.
